paragraphs: Yishmael ben Piavi, the High Priest, Parah, chapter 3, mishnah 5. Some readings give R' Elazar ben Piavi at the end of Tohorot chapter 7; our reading there is ben Pila.[^1]

notes.text: כה״ג contextually supplies High Priest for Yishmael only, without adding Rabbi. 3m 5 and end 7 preserve the locators without fresh verification or missing subsection invention. לישנגרוסין remains the exact compressed source form, contextually some readings, with machine ליש גורסין disclosed; no Hebrew division/correction is adopted. Piavi/Pila is Hyman’s reported variant contrast, not a new identity or father merger. Elazar’s abbreviated title stays R'.
